account.switchDescription: Switches to the other demo account, which carries different roles.
account.signOutDescription: Signs out, so what an anonymous session gets to see becomes visible.

command.title: Change the look
command.description: Switches the whole application to another look — colours, letterforms, icons and wording. Applying it reloads the page, because this product composes its looks at startup.
command.answers: Which look is active, whether it changed, and whether the page reloads.

arg.look: Which look to apply: default, aurora or breeze.

about.title: About
about.sample: This is a sample product that shows every feature LoomWeaver offers, all in one place. Good for seeing what is possible, less good for telling what is platform and what is sample.
about.working: We are working on that: soon each part of the demo will point to the documentation and the code behind it.
about.today: If you want to build something today, start with the documentation. It already has plenty of examples.
about.commandDescription: Shows what this demo is, its version and where the documentation is.
